title: B3 DCM centerline geometry parse-and-expose: sibling measurement module typing the polyline geometry already arriving on the accepted transport's wire (EPSG:2263, CRS-validated, fail-closed)
objective: Implement B3 per the accepted M4-T016 A2 research (Part 4.3 item 1, Parts 2.3/3.1): a NEW sibling measurement module services/api/app/connectors/dcm_street_centerline_geometry.py (the mappluto_lot_outline.py-beside-mappluto_geometry_arcgis.py precedent) plus its test file, parsing, CRS-validating, and typing the esriGeometryPolyline geometry that ALREADY arrives on the accepted DCM transport's segment-query wire (returnGeometry defaults TRUE; the accepted parse_segment_page deliberately discards geometry and stays byte-unchanged). Contract: (1) parse features[].geometry.paths from the same page body the accepted transport fetches - typed polylines (tuples of finite (x,y) floats), multi-path segments preserved, paired with the segment's identity/attributes; reuse the accepted module's fetch/validation surfaces by READ-ONLY import - never re-implement transport, never issue a second fetch for the same page; (2) CRS fail-closed - the response spatialReference must be wkid 102718 / latestWkid 2263 (EPSG:2263, US survey feet, per M4-T016 Part 2.3 evidence); anything else or absent -> typed error, NEVER assumed or reprojected; this is the MEASUREMENT-grade sibling (display-only 4326 stays mappluto_lot_outline's job); (3) geometry-validity taxonomy per the mappluto_geometry_arcgis precedent - feature with attributes but null/missing geometry, empty paths, path with <2 points, non-numeric or non-finite coordinates are each a TYPED state/error, never a silent drop (B4's buffer correctness depends on absence being visible); (4) values pass through untouched - no rounding, simplification, averaging, or unit conversion; (5) provenance carried per output (source layer/version fields the transport exposes, retrieval identity, raw-body digest passthrough); (6) zero new dependencies; accepted connector modules all READ-ONLY. Producer report saved to project-control/reports/M4-T020-producer-report.md.
